Warnings: Illinois Gaming Board: The comparable land-based gaming revenue field is a transparent cross-jurisdiction crosswalk; Illinois Total AGR remains separately preserved under its regulator-specific metric key.
Michigan Gaming Control Board: Michigan tribal casino revenue is not included because the reviewed MGCB public workbook covers only the three Detroit commercial casinos.
Michigan Gaming Control Board: Retail sports-betting QAGR is excluded from the land-based comparable gaming-revenue metric and must not be silently added.
Ohio Casino Control Commission: Ohio Lottery-regulated video-lottery racino revenue is not included in this OCCC casino report and requires its own provider.
Ohio Casino Control Commission: Sports-gaming receipts are excluded from the land-based comparable gaming-revenue metric.

Ohio Lottery Commission: Ohio Lottery Net Win is preserved separately from Ohio Casino Control Commission Total Revenue; the two statutory regulator series are not relabeled as one jurisdiction-specific metric.
Ohio Lottery Commission: Table-game revenue and sports-gaming receipts are outside the Ohio Lottery VLT series.

Regulator figures are subject to adjustment; comparable revenue preserves published Total AGR. Hybrid subtotals are nonadditive in some source months; those records retain an explicit anomaly flag for definition review.
